dict.string: Lyneqo Caravan & Motorhome uses the camera to photograph vehicle plates, CRiS VIN Chip stickers, tyres, maintenance records, and accident scenes — including other vehicles, number plates, and documents the other driver chooses to show (such as a driving licence or Green Card).
Lyneqo Caravan & Motorhome can attach existing photos to vehicle plates, CRiS VIN Chip stickers, tyre, maintenance and accident records, including documents shown after an accident.
Lyneqo Caravan & Motorhome can record your approximate location if you choose to log an accident, so your insurer pack includes where it happened.

Lyneqo Caravan & Motorhome can copy your name, address and phone from a contact you choose — typically My Card — when you record an accident, so you can share them with the other driver. Details are stored on that incident only.
